features.name: Stripe
features.description: Card and wallet payments on Stripe Checkout with the merchant's own Stripe keys; also Stripe subscriptions.

features.name: PayPal
features.description: PayPal checkout with the merchant's own PayPal app; also PayPal subscriptions.

features.name: PayFast (South Africa)
features.description: Payments on PayFast South Africa's own page (payfast.co.za, ZAR) with the merchant's own PayFast account.

features.name: PayFast (Pakistan)
features.description: Payments on PayFast Pakistan's hosted checkout (gopayfast, PKR) with the merchant's own PayFast account.

features.name: JazzCash
features.description: Payments on JazzCash's hosted checkout with the merchant's own JazzCash account.

features.name: Easypaisa
features.description: Payments on Easypaisa's hosted checkout (Easypay) with the merchant's own store.

features.name: Rapid Gateway
features.description: Payments on Rapid Gateway's hosted checkout (card, Easypaisa, JazzCash, Raast; PKR) with the merchant's own Rapid account.

features.name: Bank transfer (manual)
features.description: Shows the merchant's bank details; the payer may upload a proof to the merchant's own storage and the merchant confirms receipt.

features.name: Generic gateway adapter
features.description: Any other gateway: the payer is sent to its checkout address with signed fields and it confirms with a signed notice.

features.name: Payment links
features.description: Reusable links for any amount (invoices, bookings, donations), with a hosted page and the pay button.

features.name: Merchant payment API
features.description: The merchant's server (and Ecommerce through a pasted token) creates, reads and verifies payments; the Payments admin widget.

features.name: Subscriptions
features.description: Gateway-managed subscriptions on Stripe and PayPal; Payments mirrors their status; the Subscriptions admin widget.

features.name: Refunds
features.description: Full and partial refunds by API or the Payments admin widget, recorded in the payment's history.
